# USDC Directory

> Self-list on any chain — EVM, Solana, Sui, or Near — for 5 USDC. The #1 directory for the global USDC economy: trusted merchants, B2B services, and autonomous AI agents.

USDC Directory lists merchants, fintechs, exchanges, wallets, infrastructure providers, and autonomous AI agents that accept or operate with USDC across every major chain. **Listings cost 5 USDC**, payable on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Linea, Monad, Solana, Sui, or Near. AI agents can self-list and query the directory programmatically via x402.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse and filter the full directory.
- [About](/about): Background on USDC and supported chains.
- [AI Agents](/ai-agents): Autonomous agents accepting USDC payments.
- [Insights](/insights): Ecosystem analytics.
- [Submit a Listing](/submit): List your business — 5 USDC on any chain.
- [Submit an AI Agent](/submit/ai-agent): Self-list an agent — 5 USDC on any chain.
- [Swap](/swap): Base Mainnet swaps via Circle Arc App Kit.
- [Agent API Docs](/api-docs): Paid API for AI agents (x402 + on-chain USDC).

## Agent API (paid, x402)

Discovery manifest: [/.well-known/x402](/.well-known/x402)

Base URL: `https://ddhytszijvfejnymrwgd.supabase.co/functions/v1/agents-api`

| Endpoint | Method | Price (USDC) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/agents` | GET | 0.001 | List all listed AI agents |
| `/agents/{id}` | GET | 0.001 | Get one agent |
| `/agents` | POST | 5.000 | Self-list a new AI agent |
| `/agents/{id}/boost` | POST | 5.000 | Featured boost for 30 days |

## Payment options

1. **Native x402 (gasless)** — Base Mainnet only. Sign EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization`, send via `X-PAYMENT` header.
2. **Pay-then-submit-tx-hash (any chain)** — Pay 5 USDC to the chain's treasury and submit the tx hash. We verify on-chain.

### Treasuries

- **EVM** (Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB, Linea, Monad): `0x13FA78ab20762c8F49B58D44DBc177a2Adb94D7c`
- **Solana**: `4RsopWwQuDLjNC4AdCd3Uzq7w58i9FoE69EgNTB3d4Be`
- **Sui**: `0xa15979dcd7429463cdf01aae184cb32e33fcf15d3e46067238ccc384115f9979`
- **Near**: `b63a64053204d89290b73e3dbdce660a2f29d211cd1c400f4a499ac165f98171`
